In [[algebraic geometry]], the '''Igusa quartic''' (also called the '''Castelnuovo–Richmond quartic'''  ''CR''<sub>4</sub> or the '''Castelnuovo–Richmond–Igusa quartic''') is a quartic [[hypersurface]] in 4-dimensional [[projective space]], studied by {{harvs|txt|last=Igusa|year=1962|authorlink= Jun-ichi Igusa}}.
It is closely related to the [[moduli space]] of genus 2 curves with level 2 structure. It is the dual of the [[Segre cubic]].

It can be given as a codimension 2 variety in ''P''<sup>5</sup> by the equations
:<math>\sum x_i=0</math>
:<math>\big(\sum x_i^2\big)^2 = 4 \sum x_i^4</math>
